compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: When the migration-class marker resolves to `db`, the decomposer co-authors — in the same plan as the forward migration — a three-task unit: the forward migration, a rollback migration, and a rollback-verification task (THREE-task co-authored unit).
- dd-2: The decomposer classifies the rollback as one of safe-revert / compensating-forward / ambiguous, defaulting ambiguous cases to compensating-forward and flagging them with a DATA LOSS RISK annotation.
- dd-3: The rollback-verification task's done-definition asserts on post-rollback schema state (not merely that the rollback command exits 0).

## TDD Exemption
behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5 (non-executable LLM instruction / contract artifact): plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md and plugins/dso/docs/contracts/migration-class-marker.md are English-prose instruction/contract files with no executable code path of their own. This task authors no separate RED unit test; its behavior is validated by task-1's structural-boundary suite (test-task-decomposer-db-case.sh), which transitions RED→GREEN when this prose lands. testing_mode GREEN.

## Implementation
Fill the reserved `db` case in plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md (inline prose) and reconcile the consumer description in plugins/dso/docs/contracts/migration-class-marker.md so the contract's db-value behavior and the decomposer db-case prose stay in lockstep.

The db-case prose MUST instruct the decomposer to:
- Read the PASSED-IN migration-class marker (last MIGRATION_CLASS: comment; hyphenated `migration-class` key per the contract) and branch on the `db` value. task-decomposer is prohibited from ticket/shell access — it reads the passed-in {migration-marker}, never self-fetches.
- (clause d / dd-1) Co-author, in the SAME plan, a THREE-task unit: the FORWARD MIGRATION task, a ROLLBACK MIGRATION task (reserved `rollback` task-type namespace), and a ROLLBACK-VERIFICATION task (reserved `rollback-verification` namespace). State explicitly that the forward migration is part of the co-authored triple — NOT merely "add rollback tasks alongside an existing forward migration". All three emitted together as one cohesive unit.
- (clause b / dd-2) Classify the rollback: additive → `safe-revert`; destructive (drop column/table, rename, type narrowing) → `compensating-forward`; AMBIGUOUS/unmatched → default `compensating-forward` AND lead the rollback task description with a literal `DATA LOSS RISK` note.
- (clause c / dd-3) Give the rollback-verification task a done-definition that asserts on post-rollback SCHEMA STATE (e.g. column/table presence or absence after rollback), not merely that the rollback command exits 0.

DETERMINISTIC dispatch-point precondition: ef21 has a story-level depends_on edge to sibling 1c2b, which establishes the migration-class dispatch point + reserved `db` case header. EXPECT them to already exist; fill the prose into the existing reserved header. DEFENSIVE fallback (single deterministic instruction, no OR): if — and only if — the dispatch point or reserved db header is absent at run time, add the reserved db case header at the dispatch point as part of this edit rather than failing. Expected path = it already exists.

CO-COMMIT RATIONALE: task-decomposer.md and migration-class-marker.md MUST be edited and committed together because they are a producer/consumer contract pair. The contract doc's db-value description and the decomposer db-case prose describe the same behavior from two sides; splitting across commits would let them DRIFT and mislead the other contract consumers — sibling story c5fa and E2E story 2bd4 — that read migration-class-marker.md as the normative source of truth.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] task-1's db-case structural suite now passes (RED→GREEN)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-db-case.sh
- [ ] Clause a — db case prescribes both rollback task-types
  Verify: grep -iE 'rollback' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md | grep -qiE 'verification'
- [ ] Clause b — classification tokens + DATA LOSS RISK ambiguity default present
  Verify: grep -F 'safe-revert' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md && grep -F 'compensating-forward' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md && grep -F 'DATA LOSS RISK' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- [ ] Clause c — rollback-verification done-def asserts schema state
  Verify: grep -iE 'schema state|post-rollback schema|resulting schema' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- [ ] Clause d (dd-1) — db case describes the THREE-task co-authored unit including the forward migration
  Verify: grep -iE 'forward migration' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md | grep -iE 'co-author|three-task|triple|same plan'
- [ ] db-case prose instructs reading the PASSED-IN marker (no self-fetch)
  Verify: grep -qiE 'passed.in|migration-marker' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- [ ] Contract doc reconciled — migration-class-marker.md db-value description matches the decomposer db-case behavior
  Verify: grep -qiE 'rollback' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/migration-class-marker.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
